input-field.name: enabled
input-field.label: Enable the quote agent
input-field.helpText: Off by default. While off the agent is completely silent: it queues nothing and writes nothing.

input-field.name: rulesOnlyMode
input-field.label: Rules-only mode (no model call)
input-field.helpText: Decide grant / counter / escalate deterministically without calling a model. An explicit choice, never a fallback on error.

input-field.name: llmApiKey
input-field.label: LLM API key
input-field.helpText: Your own key. Stored in system_config, obscured here but NOT encrypted at rest. Required in every mode, including rules-only: interpreting a buyer's free-text ask is itself a model call.

input-field.name: llmBaseUrl
input-field.label: LLM base URL
input-field.helpText: Point at Azure, your own gateway or a self-hosted model.

input-field.name: llmModel
input-field.label: Model name
input-field.helpText: The model to send each request to, e.g. gpt-4o-mini. Required: there is deliberately no default, because guessing one would pick a price and quality point for you.

input-field.name: negotiationStrategy
input-field.label: Negotiation strategy
input-field.helpText: Tone and commercial posture, e.g. "open at 2%, concede in 1% steps, never lead with the maximum". Appended to the base prompt. It can never move a cap — the bands below are the guardrail.

input-field.name: maxDiscountPercent
input-field.label: Maximum discount (%)
input-field.helpText: 0 means every price ask escalates to a human.

input-field.name: counterOfferMaxPercent
input-field.label: Counter-offer ceiling (%)
input-field.helpText: An ask above the maximum but at or below this gets a deterministic counter at the maximum. Blank means no counter band.

input-field.name: maxQuoteValueNet
input-field.label: Maximum quote value for auto-reply (net)
input-field.helpText: Above this the quote always escalates. Blank means no ceiling.

input-field.name: maxQuoteValueCurrency
input-field.label: Currency of that ceiling (ISO 4217, e.g. EUR)
input-field.helpText: Blank means the ceiling is compared without a currency check.

input-field.name: deliveryCommittedLeadTimeDaysMin
input-field.label: Shortest lead time the agent may commit to (days)

input-field.name: paymentAllowedTerms
input-field.label: Payment terms the agent may grant

input-field.name: bundleVolumeTiers
input-field.label: Volume tiers, one per line
input-field.helpText: Format minQty:discountPercent, e.g. "10:5" then "50:7.5" on the next line. A line that does not parse makes the whole configuration invalid — the agent escalates rather than applying half a ladder.
